title: Why Claire Redfield rode into Resident Evil 2's Raccoon City
subject: claire
description:
Would you have gone into Raccoon City for your brother? 👇

Why Claire Redfield left college and rode into a dying city in September 1998. Spoilers for Resident Evil 2.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Claire Redfield rode into Raccoon City looking for one man.
In August 1998, her brother Chris flew to Europe to dig into Umbrella. Then the calls stopped.
Weeks later, Claire left college and got on her motorcycle. "I have to find my brother."
The city was already falling. A diner cook attacked her, and a rookie cop, Leon Kennedy, pulled her out.
At the police station, Lieutenant Marvin Branagh gave her a combat knife. Later, he turned too.
Chris was never there. Claire walked into Raccoon City for a brother who had already left it.
